Name: Artisan Valley for Better Kegs Mod
Author: DraconisLeonidas
Description:
Adds compatibility for Artisan Valley to the upgraded kegs from Better Kegs Mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6978236]Billeh007[/url].

NOTE: The recipes using Milk/Goat's Milk will not show up using Lookup Anything. This is an issue with base Artisan Valley as well and I'm unaware if there's a way to fix this, it's likely just some issue with the way AV is set up. These items can still be made using the upgraded kegs.

Open to making compatibility files for other mods, feel free to make suggestions!
